import currency
import con_uwarriors_lst001  
I = importlib
          
S = Hash(default_value=None)
metadata = Hash(default_value=0)
balances = Hash(default_value=0)
wp = ForeignHash(foreign_contract='con_uwarriors_lst001', foreign_name='balances')          

@construct          
def seed():
    metadata['operator'] = ctx.caller
    metadata['nitro_cost'] = 120
    metadata['nitro_cost_pay'] = 80
    metadata['fees'] = decimal('0.15')
    metadata['nitro_cost_init'] = 120
    metadata['nitro_cost_init_pay'] = 80
    metadata['demand_cost'] = 10
    metadata['time'] = 120
    metadata['delivery'] = now


@export
def nitro_send_cost(contract: str, item_contract: str, uid: str, to: str, cost:float):
  sender = ctx.caller
  thing_master_owner = I.import_module(item_contract)
  owner = thing_master_owner.get_owner(uid)
  
  assert wp[sender] >= metadata['nitro_cost_pay'] +  cost, 'Not enough coins to send!'
  assert owner  == sender , 'Not Owner'
  
  con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(metadata['nitro_cost_pay'],  metadata['operator'], sender)
  metadata['nitro_cost_pay'] += metadata['demand_cost']

  if (now - metadata['delivery']).minutes >= metadata['time']: 
      metadata['nitro_cost_pay']  = metadata['nitro_cost_init_pay']

  metadata['delivery'] = now
  
  thing_master_contract = I.import_module(contract)         
  thing_master_contract.transfer_from(
        uid=uid,
        to=ctx.this,
        main_account=ctx.caller,
        contract=item_contract)  
 

  balances[uid] = True
  balances[uid, 'item'] = {owner: owner, contract: contract, item_contract: item_contract, uid: uid, to: to, cost: cost}
  

@export
def nitro_send_cancel(uid: str):
  sender = ctx.caller
  item = balances[uid, 'item']

  assert balances[uid] == True , 'Not Owner'

  thing_master_contract = I.import_module(item['contract'])         
  thing_master_contract.transfer(
            uid=uid,
            to=item['owner'],
            main_account=ctx.this,
            contract=item['item_contract'])

  balances[uid, 'item'] = ''
  balances[uid] = False


@export
def nitro_send_confirm(uid: str):
  sender = ctx.caller
  item = balances[uid, 'item']

  assert wp[sender] >= item['cost'] , 'Not enough coins to send!'
  assert balances[uid] == True , 'Not Send'
  assert item[to] == sender , 'Not delivery receiver'

  price_amount_pay = item['cost'] - (item['cost'] * metadata['fees'])

  con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(price_amount_pay, item[owner], sender)
  con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from((item['cost'] * metadata['fees']), metadata['operator'], sender)

  thing_master_contract = I.import_module(item['contract'])         
  thing_master_contract.transfer(
            uid=uid,
            to=item[to],
            main_account=ctx.this,
            contract=item['item_contract'])

  balances[uid, 'item'] = ''
  balances[uid] == False


@export
def nitro_send_free(contract: str, item_contract: str, uid: str, to: str):
  sender = ctx.caller
  thing_master_owner = I.import_module(item_contract)
  owner = thing_master_owner.get_owner(uid)

  assert wp[sender] >= metadata['nitro_cost'] , 'Not enough coins to send!'
  assert owner  == sender , 'Not Owner'
  
  con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer_from(metadata['nitro_cost'],  metadata['operator'], sender)
  metadata['nitro_cost'] += metadata['demand_cost']

  if (now - metadata['delivery']).minutes >= metadata['time']: 
    metadata['nitro_cost']  = metadata['nitro_cost_init']
  
  metadata['delivery'] = now
 
  thing_master_contract = I.import_module(contract)         
  thing_master_contract.transfer_from(
        uid=uid,
        to=to,
        main_account=ctx.caller,
        contract=item_contract)  

@export
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only operator can set metadata!'
    metadata[key] = value


@export 
def operator_transfer_thing(uid: str, new_owner: str, contract: str, item_contract: str):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only auction operator can transfer things from contract.'
    thing_master_contract = I.import_module(contract)
    thing_master_contract.transfer(uid=uid, new_owner=new_owner, contract=item_contract)
    S[uid] = False


@export
def operator_transfer_currency(amount: str, to: float):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['operator'], 'Only auction operator can transfer currency from contract.'
    con_uwarriors_lst001.transfer(amount=amount, to=to)
